summary: Environment A direct-binary proof that Phase 24.2 (real, bounded interim whisper.cpp decoding in WhisperSpeechEngine) is genuinely compiled into this rebuilt installer, with zero functional regression to every prior-phase Rust symbol.
gitCommitNote: This is the source tree commit (Phase 24.2's own commit) this rebuild was performed against. Phase 24.2 touches ai/speech/src/whisper.rs, apps/desktop/src/components/LiveChurchBrain.tsx, apps/desktop/src/components/LiveChurchBrain.css, docs/live-speech.md, and adds docs/phase-24-2-audit.md. This is the second consecutive rebuild this session (following Phase 24.1's gitCommit 472b91a) - both closed real gaps identified by continuing directly from the operator's own follow-up direction.
buildLog: ran directly in this session (not committed - ephemeral build log)

installer.ggmlTwoPassFixNote: First build attempt failed as expected on the known whisper-rs-sys ggml lib-name defect; the build script applied its established fix and the retry succeeded - the same harmless, unrelated build-toolchain quirk documented and handled identically in every prior whisper-enabled Windows rebuild this project has done.

symbolRegressionCheck.method: x86_64-w64-mingw32-strings cip-desktop.exe | grep -c <symbol>, run against the extracted installer's main executable. Every tripwire from Phase 24.1's own baseline (the most recent prior rebuild) was re-checked; all matched exactly with zero deviation.
symbolRegressionCheck.tripwiresFromPriorPhasesDeviation: None. All 24 pre-existing tripwire symbols matched their Phase 24.1 baseline count exactly.

newTripwiresThisPhase.note: decode_pass and try_interim_decode (the two new functions the interim-decoding feature actually depends on) are confirmed present and compiled in. should_flush_early (pre-existing since Phase 21, never previously tracked as a tripwire in this project's evidence files) and should_attempt_interim_decode (new this phase) are both absent from the symbol table - expected release-mode optimizer inlining for a small, pure function called from only one or two call sites within the same file, the same established class of benign variance already documented for classify_model_size_tier (Phase 22), retry_paraphrase_or_semantic_with_fuller_context (Phase 22's own inlining), and should_flush_early/has_trailing_pause themselves (Phase 21's own evidence, though not re-verified as a tripwire until this build). Their correctness is proven instead by direct unit tests (4 new tests for should_attempt_interim_decode, all passing) rather than symbol presence.

frontendTextSearchLimitation: The frontend bundle is not searchable as plain strings inside cip-desktop.exe the same way Rust symbols are - the new interimTranscript state/effect in LiveChurchBrain.tsx and its rendering in the Live Transcript panel were not independently string-searched, consistent with every prior phase's methodology. Frontend correctness rests on npm run typecheck's success, the full 303/303 frontend test pass (unchanged), and real-browser-engine event-simulation verification using Tauri's own official @tauri-apps/api/mocks module (see docs/phase-24-2-audit.md), which confirmed the interim line appears on an is_final:false TRANSCRIPT_UPDATED event and is correctly replaced by the permanent, timestamped entry once that window's is_final:true event arrives.
architecturalSafetyNotes: Zero new Tauri commands, zero new events, zero new migrations, zero schema changes.

decode_pass and try_interim_decode never mutate self.buffer/self.elapsed_ms/self.sequence - only run_inference (the pre-existing final-decode path, functionally unchanged) does, preserving the pre-existing buffer/clock-consumed-before-fallible-decode ordering that prevents a decode error from leaving stale audio stuck in the buffer forever.

commands.rs's real-time worker, core/ai's SpeechEngine trait, and every other domain contract crate (core/bible, core/sermon, core/music, core/presentation, core/service) are entirely untouched - the interim-segment handling this phase now actually exercises was already correct code, unexercised until this phase gave WhisperSpeechEngine something non-final to emit.
Every prior-phase command and symbol remains present and unregressed - zero deviation across all 24 pre-existing tripwires, confirming this phase's addition did not disturb any prior gate or feature.
environmentCStatus: Not yet performed. A real operator watching the Live Transcript panel during an actual sentence on real hardware with a real Whisper model and confirming the interim line is legible and useful (not distracting, and correctly replaced once they pause) is required to close Environment C for this phase.
